digest.component_or_area: workflow gates (plan review and completion verification)
propositions: Add a configurable [verify] maximum-description setting with default 8,000 characters; exactly 8,000 is allowed, 8,001+ blocks.
Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call when description exceeds the configured maximum.
Light-bug review must retain the blocking P4 description finding in det_blocking while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.
Completion verification must check the authoritative ticket description against the [verify] setting and return deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls if exceeded.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; P4 emits at most one oversize finding across all size signals.
Neither gate truncates or summarizes ticket content; operators use the force override to decompose oversized tickets below the maximum before either gate runs.
